data.name: Netherwyn
data.detailed_description:
NETHERWYN

Enter the lands of Netherwyn, a world buckling under necromancy and shadow. In this action roguelike RPG, you and your allies band together against relentless horrors while mastering the unique abilities of your heroes. Each run brings new challenges with procedurally generated levels, and ever-shifting loot that demands constant adaptation.

Gather your party in the Inn, upgrade your heroes, trade items, and descend into the unknown. From swarming zombies to towering trolls, every encounter tests your reflexes, coordination, and resolve. Die, return stronger, and push deeper.

This first release centers on the return of ancient evil The Necromancer. Delve into forgotten depths, stand against the gathering hosts of the dead, and face the dark lord himself before his shadow falls upon the world once more.

KEY FEATURES

  • Unique Heroes
    Choose from a diverse roster of heroes including the Berserker, Rogue, Shaman, Templar, and more. Each character has distinct abilities, strengths, and weaknesses, ensuring that every playthrough offers a unique tactical experience. Heroes can be switched at the Inn, where you also manage gear, skills, and upgrades.

  • Deep Mastery System
    Heroes are defined by combining two masteries (such as Warrior, Holy, Assassin, Hunter, or Elemental), creating hybrid classes with unique playstyles. For example, the Templar blends the resilience of the Warrior with the divine powers of the Holy mastery. Experiment with different combinations to discover synergies and tailor your hero to your preferred combat style.

  • Procedural Levels with Endless Variety
    Every run presents new challenges with procedurally generated levels built from modular chambers. Enemies, events, and environmental hazards are randomized, forcing players to adapt their strategy on the fly. As you progress, levels become longer, enemies grow stronger, and the stakes rise higher.

  • Challenging Enemies and Boss Encounters
    Face a wide range of foes, from swarming Zombies to Goblins and Barrow Wights. Elite enemies introduce unpredictable combat mechanics, while multi-phase bosses test your skill, teamwork, and adaptability with battles that grow deadlier with each stage.

  • Seamless Cooperative & Solo Action
    Built from the ground up for both solo and co-op play, Netherwyn lets you team up with friends or tackle challenges alone. Explore, fight, and survive together or forge your own path, coordinating strategies against hordes, combining hero abilities to overcome bosses, and experiencing greater depth and replayability with every run.

data.short_description: Netherwyn is a challenging Roguelite Action RPG where each run sends you and your allies into lands fallen beneath a gathering shadow filled with relentless hordes and deadly boss encounters. This first release centers on Return of The Necromancer.
